description: This file defines the StatusAndHealthProvider interface, which specifies methods for retrieving status and health information asynchronously in a cluster management context.

classes.name: StatusAndHealthProvider
classes.description: An interface for retrieving status and health information of a cluster asynchronously.

methods.name: retrieveStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the status information asynchronously as a JsonObject.

methods.name: retrieveHealth
methods.description: Retrieves the health information asynchronously as a StatusInfo object.
